scenarios.requirement: A session whose adapter reads and never answers fails at the start's budget naming what it waited for
An adapter that dies before it answers ends the start at once, also when a process it left behind keeps its pipe open, and the failure line says how it ended
A request the adapter never answers ends at the request budget and the session stays open
A run that does not stop within its budget answers still going and the session stays open
wpe_child_reap_install installs once, a followed child's end wakes the loop before its deadline also when a grandchild holds its pipe, and a process the caller waits for itself keeps its status
The start machine's rows hold on a wire that delivers a loopback write late: every pump waits for its descriptor
A request bigger than the adapter's pipe, sent while the adapter is not reading, is flushed by the wait on the loop and answered
An end request raised while the adapter never answers gives the start up at once, not at the start's budget, and says the end was requested
The test watchdog names what did not finish within its time, scales as a float, and keeps earlier output
